title: Biometric Consent Record
description: A record showing that written notice was given and informed consent obtained from each individual before their biometric identifiers were collected or processed.
evidence_description: A record, per individual or per data source, showing the written notice given and consent obtained before biometric identifiers were collected, including for data sourced from third parties or public scraping.
collection_method: Consent-management system logging notice delivery and consent capture at each collection point.
retention_period: For the lifetime of the biometric data held, plus a minimum of 3 years after deletion.
artifact_format: Structured export (CSV/JSON) of consent records, keyed to each collection point or data source.
